1.e4 d5 2.exd5 Qxd5 3.Nc3 Qa5 4.d4 Nf6 5.strategy: Centralises the knight on an outpost the d-pawn supports, where it eyes f7 and d7 and cramps Black's development. White plays for space and active pieces, so Black has to challenge the knight rather than just develop.
Frees c7 as a retreat for the queen and takes b5 and d5 away from the c3 knight, so it cannot jump out with tempo against the queen. Black gets a solid centre and the queen is no longer a target.
